site_name: CoreSite VA1 (Reston campus), 12100 Sunrise Valley Dr, Reston, VA 20191
verification: Not verified as the year the first building at this site began operating. What the pages do support: CRG West's colocation operation here started in 2008. DCK 2008-01-04 says CRG 'plan to have the facility open for business at some point late 1Q08' (not yet open); DCK 2008-10-08 says InfoSpace 'has moved into 1,000 square feet of space in its Reston Exchange data center' (operating), a bracket of about nine months. Why I am withholding the year: the same January 2008 article is headlined 'CRG West Buys Virginia Data Center', calls the property a 'data center and office property', says it was 'previously used by America Online', was 'significantly remodeled in 2000', and already had 60,000 square feet of raised floor. That indicates data-center use under AOL before 2008, with no opened page dating when that began. I am uncertain whether AOL ran it as a production data center; that is inference from the article's description, not a stated fact. If the study defines start as the current operator's colocation opening, 2008 is supportable at medium confidence (two pages bracket the year); if it means first data-center load at the address, 2008 is probably too late and no opened page gives the earlier year. Reader-model caveat: WebFetch returned quotes in fragments; the quoted sentence is assembled from two consecutive fragments reported as verbatim.

site_name: Equinix DC10, 21551 Beaumeade Circle, Ashburn, VA 20147
verification: The only dated statement about DC10 opening is forward-looking: the 2012-02-15 Equinix release says phase one 'is scheduled to open next month', 'This month Equinix will open DC10', and 'the first customer installs will begin in March'. Those are plans, not a start. The release is also internally inconsistent on the month (this month vs next month). I looked for a confirming page within a year: the Equinix Q1 and Q2 2012 results releases, the other 2012 Equinix release titles (Feb-Dec), and the May 2013 DC11 launch release do not mention DC10. The earliest opened pages showing DC10 operating with tenants are DCK 2014-05-20 and 2014-05-30, more than two years after the forward-looking release, so they cannot bracket 2012. 2012 remains a reasonable inference but is not supported at high or medium confidence by any page opened.
